generator: gen_rules.py (rules.json is its output; edit the generator, not the JSON)
note: One order-independent rule set for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on SGLang v0.5.23 + the vibesim-alignment-v0.5.23 fork, 4x RTX PRO 6000 (SM120), TP4/EP4, DSpark block 6. Written from this pack's own first nsys capture, not migrated from the B200 vLLM pack (different kernel vocabulary).
provenance: Capture: logs/b2_reextract/07_balanced_anchor_c16/profile_nsys (B2 rental 2026-11-06, nsys 2026.4.1 report re-exported with 2026.5.2; 94 iterations, 1.19 M kernel rows, 4 ranks). Read off the folded launch programs (`alignment label walk`) and cross-checked against the time-ordered per-stream timeline of one decode-graph iteration (sequence_7a28c257f810, 209 occurrences) and one eager 2048-token prefill (sequence_2aca2140666a).
how_rules_were_written: Every dense FP8 linear is the same two launches (per_token_group_quant_8bit_v2 + Triton _w8a8_block_fp8_matmul), so a GEMM is named by the kernel after it (before_name) and its quant takes the GEMM's operation through `before`; where the GEMM ends a body the chain runs through after_name/after instead. The decode CUDA graph is captured on ~100 streams, so tracks are short and neighbours are track-local; the few rules that key on a track-local neighbour that is not the temporal predecessor say 'graph track' in their note.
one_to_many: Operations that claim more than one slot because the measured program cannot separate them: tp_all_reduce (attn + ffn), mhc_mix_stats / mhc_combine_norm / mhc_post (attn + ffn), attn.sparse_mla (decode + prefill slots; every launch here took the prefill kernels, a 16x7-row verify is above the 64-row switch), attn.rope_kv_store (+ dspark.kv_inject.store), head.lm_head / final_rmsnorm / hc_collapse (target + dspark), prologue.embedding (+ dspark.embed), dspark.markov.w (w1 + w2). Target and DSpark-stage layer slots share suffixes, so each layer operation also covers the three draft stages.
unfired_note: At the fixpoint four bootstrap rules (a quant named by its predecessor, for GEMMs that end a body) report 'matched nothing': they fire in the first sweep, after which the `before` rule for the same operation is tried first and confirms the same label. They are needed; removing them leaves those GEMMs unmapped.

windows.note: Duration-weighted coverage from `alignment label coverage` on the analysis_kernel report.

unmapped_note: Left unmapped on purpose (no simulated slot): scheduler / page-table prologue kernels, the routed+shared residual add, _mhc_stream_mean_kernel (DSpark hidden capture, layers 37-39), verify/accept bookkeeping (argmax, softcap, accept-length broadcasts), the kv-inject RMSNorm, two folded `[2x: quant, GEMM]` draft side-stream bodies that fold a shared-down and a kv-a projection into one position, the prefill Engram id sort (cub radix sort, neighbour-less repeat bodies) and the torch elementwise/reduce bookkeeping around the indexer projections and the prefill indexer einsum. 1.6% of measured decode time, 2.1% of prefill.
